articles.title: iFixit's look inside the iPhone Duo may explain those broken screens and hinges

articles.title: Scott Walker’s The Drift will get under your skin
articles.description: In my mind, Spooky Season music comes in two distinct flavors. There are the fun, occasionally goofy songs like "The Monster Mash" and John Carpenter's "Halloween Theme." Then there is the genuinely terrifying: Throbbing Gristle, The Body, or Scott Walker's The Drift. This 2006 album from the singer-songwriter is truly upsetting. On it, Walker explores […]

articles.title: A YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo and thinks he found the cause of crackgate
articles.description: Social media and the iPhone Duo subreddit are filled with reports of Apple's foldable failing quickly and in spectacular fashion.
